description: Agent preflight round 3: check your own incident response plan before you depend on it. Input text, fields (detection, severity_levels, notification_windows, roles, customer_communication, postmortem, payment_incidents) or both. The signed report marks each area covered, partial or not covered, with quotes, the severity levels and notification windows it reads, and names each gap plainly: no detection path, no notification window, no named owner, no customer communication, no postmortem practice and no path for an incident that involves payments. To check a vendor’s past incident record against its claims, use wever_incident-evidence-check. POST /api/incident-plan-check. Reads only the material in the call: no page fetch, no registry or chain lookup, no counterparty contact, and no payment signed, submitted or moved. Paid URL: 0.10 USDC per call on Base via x402 exact, with the shared 10 signed-wallet free calls per rolling 30 days. Bind X-Wever-Wallet-Proof to the exact JSON arguments and the tool route. Returns a report with an Ed25519 signed receipt. Contract: /api/agent-preflight-contract. Human page: https://weverlabs.com/preflight/.

inputSchema.description: Send the text, the fields or both.

fields.description: The plan by area. A field given here takes precedence over the text for that area.

customer_communication.description: How and how often customers hear about an incident.

detection.description: How incidents are detected: monitors, alerts, paging or reports.

notification_windows.description: Who is notified within what time.

payment_incidents.description: What happens when an incident involves payments: pausing spending, freezing funds, reversing charges.

postmortem.description: The postmortem practice: when it is written, what it covers and who sees it.

roles.description: The named roles and owners: incident commander, on-call, communications.

severity_levels.description: The severity levels and what each means.

format.description: html reduces the markup to readable text first. Defaults to html when the text starts with a tag, otherwise text.

label.description: Optional name for the material, recorded in the report.

text.description: The incident response plan as written, up to 64 KB.

name: wever_incident-plan-check
title: Incident plan check
